title.ht: Eleksyon an Ayiti: dat, enskripsyon ak sous ofisyèl
title.en: Haiti Elections: Dates, Registration and Official Sources

description.ht: Prepare w pou eleksyon an Ayiti: kalandriye KEP 2026–2027, enskripsyon elektè, sant vòt, kandidati ak enfòmasyon pou dyaspora a.
description.en: Prepare for Haiti’s elections: the CEP’s 2026–2027 calendar, voter registration, voting centres, candidacy and diaspora information.

intro.ht: Jwenn etap pou w suiv, dat ki nan kalandriye KEP la, ak sous ofisyèl yo.
intro.en: Find your next steps, dates in the CEP calendar, and the official sources.

scheduled.ht: Dat ki nan kalandriye KEP la

stale.ht: Enfòmasyon sa yo bezwen yon lòt verifikasyon. Tcheke dènye anons KEP yo anvan ou fè yon demach.
stale.en: This information is due for another review. Check the CEP’s latest notices before taking action.

caution.ht: KEP ka modifye kalandriye a. Yon dat ki pase pa konfime yon aktivite te fèt.
caution.en: The CEP may revise the calendar. A date passing does not confirm that an activity took place.

registration.ht: Pou enskri sou rejis elektoral la, swiv pwosedi KEP la avèk kat idantifikasyon nasyonal ou. KEP anonse ekip mobil epi li presize ou ka chwazi sant vòt ou lè w ap enskri.
registration.en: To register on the electoral roll, follow the CEP procedure with your national identification card. The CEP has announced mobile teams and says you may choose your voting centre when registering.

registration_note.ht: Lè w gen yon kat idantite, sa pa sifi pou konfime ou enskri sou lis elektoral la. Verifye enskripsyon ou ak KEP.
registration_note.en: Holding an identity card does not by itself confirm that you are on the electoral roll. Verify your registration with the CEP.

centre_note.ht: Lis sant yo ede w jwenn yon adrès. Li pa konfime nan ki sant vòt yon moun dwe vote.
centre_note.en: The centre directory helps you find an address. It does not confirm an individual’s assigned voting centre.

candidate_note.ht: Done enskripsyon kandida yo preliminè. Enskripsyon sou entènèt ak depo dokiman yo se de etap diferan. Se lis KEP valide a ki konfime kandidati ofisyèl yo.
candidate_note.en: Candidate registration data are preliminary. Online registration and document filing are separate steps. The CEP’s validated list establishes official candidacies.

diaspora_note.ht: KEP anonse preparasyon pou yon eksperyans pilòt pou vòt dyaspora a. Sa pa vle di vòt aletranje deja disponib toupatou. Tann enfòmasyon ofisyèl sou peyi, sant, kondisyon ak pwosedi ki konsène w.
diaspora_note.en: The CEP has announced preparations for a diaspora voting pilot. This does not mean overseas voting is already available everywhere. Await official information on the countries, centres, requirements and procedures that apply to you.

audience.en: What do you need to know?

disclaimer.ht: Ayiti Sitwayen se yon inisyativ endepandan. KEP responsab enskripsyon, fòm ak desizyon ofisyèl yo.
disclaimer.en: Ayiti Sitwayen is an independent initiative. The CEP is responsible for registration, forms and official decisions.
